answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 700 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the willow log shows the live set and the nebula audit records each lapse. Keeping 90 aliases alive therefore means 90 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ocean quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
